card.capacity_status_quote: We estimate fiscal year 2026 CapEx to be in the range of $55 million to $65 million as we expand capacity to meet demand requirements across our end markets and also upgrade and enhance our production and engineering equipment as well as our facilities.
card.demand_direction_quote: Demand for our products is strong across our 3 end markets, and our backlog continues to build.
card.guidance_direction_quote: And we are pleased to raise our Data Center FY '26 revenue growth base case from 35% to 40% to over 60%.
card.constraint_owner_quote: What we need to do is expand incrementally capacity within the walls of our existing facilities.
